alcaraz_matches_2024.question: How many matches did Carlos Alcaraz play in 2024?
alcaraz_matches_2024.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS match_count FROM matches AS m JOIN players AS p ON (m.player1_id = p.player_id OR m.player2_id = p.player_id) WHERE p.first_name ILIKE 'Carlos' AND p.last_name ILIKE 'Alcaraz' AND m.match_date >= '2024-01-01' AND m.match_date < '2025-01-01' LIMIT 1000

sinner_wins_2024.question: How many matches did Jannik Sinner win in 2024?
sinner_wins_2024.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS matches_won FROM matches AS m JOIN players AS p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id WHERE (p.first_name ILIKE 'Jannik' AND p.last_name ILIKE 'Sinner') AND m.match_date >= '2024-01-01' AND m.match_date < '2025-01-01' LIMIT 1000

italian_players.question: How many players in the database are from Italy?
italian_players.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM players WHERE nationality = 'ITA' LIMIT 1000

djokovic_clay_wins.question: How many matches did Novak Djokovic win on clay between 2023 and 2025?
djokovic_clay_wins.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS matches_won FROM matches AS m JOIN tournaments AS t ON m.tournament_id = t.tournament_id JOIN players AS p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id WHERE (p.first_name ILIKE 'Novak' AND p.last_name ILIKE 'Djokovic') AND t.surface = 'clay' AND m.match_date >= '2023-01-01' AND m.match_date < '2025-01-01' LIMIT 1000

us_open_five_setters_2024.question: How many five-set matches were played at the 2024 US Open?
us_open_five_setters_2024.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS five_set_matches FROM matches AS m JOIN tournaments AS t ON m.tournament_id = t.tournament_id JOIN (SELECT match_id, COUNT(*) AS set_count FROM sets GROUP BY match_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 5) AS s ON m.match_id = s.match_id WHERE t.name ILIKE '%US Open%' AND t.year = 2024 LIMIT 1000

alcaraz_sinner_h2h.question: What's the head-to-head record between Carlos Alcaraz and Jannik Sinner?
alcaraz_sinner_h2h.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN winner_id = (SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE first_name ILIKE 'Carlos' AND last_name ILIKE 'Alcaraz' LIMIT 1) THEN 'Carlos Alcaraz' WHEN winner_id = (SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE first_name ILIKE 'Jannik' AND last_name ILIKE 'Sinner' LIMIT 1) THEN 'Jannik Sinner' ELSE 'No winner' END AS winner, COUNT(*) AS wins FROM matches AS m JOIN players AS p1 ON m.player1_id = p1.player_id JOIN players AS p2 ON m.player2_id = p2.player_id WHERE ((p1.first_name ILIKE 'Carlos' AND p1.last_name ILIKE 'Alcaraz' AND p2.first_name ILIKE 'Jannik' AND p2.last_name ILIKE 'Sinner') OR (p1.first_name ILIKE 'Jannik' AND p1.last_name ILIKE 'Sinner' AND p2.first_name ILIKE 'Carlos' AND p2.last_name ILIKE 'Alcaraz')) GROUP BY winner_id ORDER BY wins DESC LIMIT 1000

top5_wins_2024.question: Who are the top 5 players by number of match wins in 2024?
top5_wins_2024.sql: SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name, COUNT(*) AS wins FROM matches AS m JOIN players AS p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id WHERE m.match_date >= '2024-01-01' AND m.match_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.first_name, p.last_name ORDER BY wins DESC LIMIT 5

most_clay_wins_2025.question: Which player won the most matches on clay in 2025?
most_clay_wins_2025.sql: SELECT p.player_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, COUNT(*) AS matches_won FROM matches AS m JOIN tournaments AS t ON m.tournament_id = t.tournament_id JOIN players AS p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id WHERE t.surface = 'clay' AND t.year = 2025 AND m.winner_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.player_id, p.first_name, p.last_name ORDER BY matches_won DESC LIMIT 1

sinner_ranking_2024.question: Show Jannik Sinner's ranking trend over 2024.
sinner_ranking_2024.sql: SELECT rh.ranking_date, rh.rank, rh.points FROM rankings_history AS rh JOIN players AS p ON rh.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.first_name ILIKE 'Jannik' AND p.last_name ILIKE 'Sinner' AND rh.ranking_date >= '2024-01-01' AND rh.ranking_date < '2025-01-01' ORDER BY rh.ranking_date ASC LIMIT 1000

sinner_weeks_at_no1_2024.question: In how many weekly rankings during 2024 was Jannik Sinner ranked number 1?
sinner_weeks_at_no1_2024.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rankings_history AS rh JOIN players AS p ON rh.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.first_name ILIKE 'Jannik' AND p.last_name ILIKE 'Sinner' AND rh.rank = 1 AND rh.ranking_date >= '2024-01-01' AND rh.ranking_date < '2025-01-01' LIMIT 1000

three_titles_2025.question: Which players won at least 3 tournaments in 2025?
three_titles_2025.sql: SELECT p.player_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tournament_id) AS tournaments_won FROM players AS p JOIN matches AS m ON (p.player_id = m.winner_id) JOIN tournaments AS t ON m.tournament_id = t.tournament_id WHERE t.year = 2025 AND m.round = 'F' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.first_name, p.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.tournament_id) >= 3 ORDER BY tournaments_won DESC LIMIT 100

medvedev_losses_followup.question: Now just the ones he lost.
medvedev_losses_followup.sql: SELECT m.match_id, t.name AS tournament, t.year, m.match_date, m.round, CASE WHEN m.player1_id = p.player_id THEN p2.first_name || ' ' || p2.last_name ELSE p1.first_name || ' ' || p1.last_name END AS opponent, CASE WHEN m.winner_id = p.player_id THEN 'W' WHEN m.winner_id IS NULL THEN 'N/A' ELSE 'L' END AS result FROM matches AS m JOIN tournaments AS t ON m.tournament_id = t.tournament_id JOIN players AS p ON (m.player1_id = p.player_id OR m.player2_id = p.player_id) JOIN players AS p1 ON m.player1_id = p1.player_id JOIN players AS p2 ON m.player2_id = p2.player_id WHERE (p.first_name ILIKE 'Daniil' AND p.last_name ILIKE 'Medvedev') AND m.match_date >= '2024-01-01' AND m.match_date < '2025-01-01' AND m.winner_id <> p.player_id AND m.winner_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m.match_date LIMIT 100

injuries_naming_trap.question: Which players have had an injury lasting more than 30 days?
injuries_naming_trap.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.player_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, i.injury_type, i.start_date, i.end_date, (i.end_date - i.start_date) AS days_injured FROM injuries AS i JOIN players AS p ON i.player_ref = p.player_id WHERE i.end_date IS NOT NULL AND (i.end_date - i.start_date) > 30 LIMIT 100
